column1: # The repository's history was rewritten once, to purge an API key that had
# been committed to `scripts/llm_m2_curve.py` in the Phase 3 era. Removing a
# secret from a commit necessarily changes that commit's hash and every
# descendant's, so 99 of 175 commits received new ids.
# Every experiment under `experiments/` records the commit that produced it in
# its own `git_commit.txt`. Those files still hold the ORIGINAL hashes, because
# rewriting a recorded result to match a later convenience is exactly what this
# project's provenance rules exist to prevent.
# This file is the bridge. Look up a recorded hash here to find the commit that
# carries the same tree in the current history.
# Columns: old_sha<TAB>new_sha. Identical values mean the commit predates the
# purge point and was not rewritten.
